iteration_count.description: Total PreToolUse fires this session. Equal to read_count + write_count. Preserved for backward compatibility (v1.6.0 and earlier emitted only this counter).

iteration_ceiling.description: Global cap on iteration_count (read_count + write_count). Defaults to read_ceiling + write_ceiling + 100 when LOOP_BREAKER_ITER_CEILING is not set in env. v1.7.0+ — per-class ceilings (read_ceiling / write_ceiling) typically fire first; this remains as a global safety net and is the lever existing operator overrides set.

read_count.description: v1.7.0+. PreToolUse fires for read-class tools (Read, Glob, Grep). Anti-fantasy mandates ~30 reads per agent before any write — those reads are not runaway behavior, so read_count gets its own (looser) ceiling.

read_ceiling.description: v1.7.0+. Hard ceiling on read_count. Default 600 (LOOP_BREAKER_READ_CEILING). Sized for full-stack vertical-slice sub-agents and orchestrator-style main sessions that legitimately exceed the v1.6.0 single-counter cap of 150 with exploration reads.

write_count.description: v1.7.0+. PreToolUse fires for write-class tools (Edit, Write, MultiEdit, Bash, Agent, Task, WebFetch, WebSearch, MCP, etc.). Write-class loops are the runaway-dangerous signal.

write_ceiling.description: v1.7.0+. Hard ceiling on write_count. Default 150 (LOOP_BREAKER_WRITE_CEILING). Equals the v1.6.0 single-counter cap — preserves the runaway-write safety guard that motivated the original feature.

usd_spent.description: Cumulative cost in USD. Computed PostToolUse from CQR price table.

usd_ceiling.description: Hard cost ceiling; halt fires when usd_spent > usd_ceiling.

hash_window.description: Last 10 canonical sha256 hashes; rolling FIFO.

hash_collisions.description: Count of duplicate hashes in the current 10-call window. Halt fires at 3.
